finalText:
It builds clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount` — so it crashed reading `.toFixed` off `undefined`. Now reads `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true`/`false` for the backoff flag, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` — so it threw instead of just treating that as disabled. Now anything but `true` is disabled.

The rest was 8 harmless deprecation/lint-style warnings baked into the log — those are still there and expected.
